cand.title: Cell Press Symposia: Functional RNAs
cand.organizationName: Cell Press in partnership with University of Geneva and Swiss Initiative for RNA & Disease
cand.excerpt: High evidence and date quality; ranking tempered where venue is already committed or hotel access is unconfirmed.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Marie-Claire Morley is the edition’s named registration-support and family-award contact; she is the best operational routing candidate, but hotel purchasing authority is unverified. Ramesh Pillai is a named scientific organizer and local University of Geneva/SIRD relationship route, not a proven housing buyer. Chris Holmkvist, Sr Sales Manager, Conferences, Elsevier, is explicitly responsible for exhibition/sponsorship queries; use only for exhibitor introductions or routing, not as an assumed hotel buyer.
findings.futureEdition: Officially announced activity: 25–27 October 2027, Geneva, Switzerland, within the requested horizon. These are symposium dates, not publication dates. No later Functional RNAs edition was identified.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel brief: YOTEL Geneva Lake is a conditional satellite-lodging option, not a replacement primary venue. The symposium is already assigned to Geneva city; Founex adds a commute relative to the city-focused access instructions. Consider only a modest, organizer-validated speaker/lab/exhibitor group if lodging is not centrally contracted. The supplied 20–120-room guidance is a sales ceiling/range, not event demand. Attendance and room demand are unverified, so neither size fit nor a full-house requirement can be claimed. Its meeting rooms could support a separately requested ancillary meeting; no such demand is published. This is not a resort-retreat brief; banquet/catering scale remains unverified.
findings.venueCommitments: The official site states: “will take place at Fondation Campus Biotech Geneva”. Exact address: 9 Chemin des Mines, CH-1202 Genève, Switzerland. Territory: Geneva city, Canton of Geneva; not Founex/Nyon/La Côte or an airport-corridor venue. This is a published venue commitment, not proof of signed contract terms. No competing host hotel is named.
findings.historicalRotation: The official archive lists Functional RNAs, 20–22 October 2024, Beijing, China. The next identified announced edition is Geneva, 25–27 October 2027. The 2024 exact venue and incumbent hotels could not be recovered: former edition pages now display generic series text. This establishes two destination observations, not an annual or triennial rotation policy. Regulatory RNAs entries are not assumed to be the same series.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Edition-specific accommodation page: “More information coming soon...”. Hotels listed: none. It also states: “All accommodation bookings should be made directly through the conference hotel(s), using the accommodation booking link on the website where specified.” This is a booking instruction, not a published 2027 room block. No authorized housing bureau, open hotel RFP, allotment, rate or booking deadline is verified. EHS, EHM and BTM appear only in a fraud warning and must not be treated as appointed suppliers. Hotel sourcing remains unconfirmed, not open.
findings.organizationStructure: Publisher-led scientific symposium presented by Cell Press in partnership with the University of Geneva and Swiss Initiative for RNA & Disease. The edition identifies the Elsevier Conferences team in scholarship administration and Elsevier staff in sponsorship. SIRD describes itself as a non-profit scientific association established in March 2026. Campus Biotech is the announced venue, not the event owner or hotel buyer. No edition-specific external PCO/DMC appointment or accommodation contracting entity is verified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Primary meeting-venue displacement is not a credible 2027 pitch because Campus Biotech is announced. No incumbent accommodation hotels, sold-out inventory, overflow need or room-night figures are verified. The official access guidance routes airport arrivals through Geneva Cornavin to Campus Biotech, supporting a city-centered itinerary; it does not establish lodging toward La Côte. Do not turn the generic “Conference Hotel” wording on the accessibility page into a named hotel commitment.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: First ask Marie-Claire Morley at the published edition address m.morley@elsevier.com who manages hotel selection and whether 2027 accommodation is centrally contracted, already allocated or still being evaluated. Request the complete hotel list, pickup/peak-room requirements, dates including shoulder nights, and whether a Founex option with costed transfers is acceptable. If accommodation is uncontracted and geography acceptable, offer a limited satellite group proposal, not whole-house or primary-venue displacement. Ask Ramesh Pillai for local introductions only if needed; use Chris Holmkvist only for exhibitor-group routing. Do not hold speculative inventory or quote banquet capacity without validation.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: 2027 is a confirmed future edition as of 17 November 2026. Accommodation access is unresolved: no published hotel list does not mean inventory is available. Official airport guidance says “All trains stop at Geneva main station” and then directs delegates to tram 15 or bus 25 to Campus Biotech. This supports Geneva Airport access, not Founex lodging. The activity is neither Lausanne nor across the French border. Treat individual transit/ticket instructions as information to reconfirm for 2027.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: develop the Cell Press/Elsevier and local organizer relationship for future small scientific meetings or satellite lodging. Beijing 2024 and Geneva 2027 show destination variation but do not establish recurring Geneva demand, an open future venue contest or another announced edition after 2027. Do not label this recurring competitive capture yet.
